blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Adapting foundation models to a new task within or beyond the training domain is the de facto standard for building specialized machine learning models. Recently, Visual Prompting (VP) has emerged as a promising technique for efficient knowledge transfer. As new foundation model families~(like Mamba) get introduced and VP pipelines such as AutoVP reach greater maturity, we find a growing need for a systematic evaluation of current approaches. In this work, we assess the performance of the latest models, comparing them to earlier architectures and alternative fine-tuning methods, to better understand the progress, challenges and opportunities in the field of efficient fine-tuning under resource limitations. Towards this goal, this paper provides a concise empirical overview of the interactions among foundation model families (Attention-, Convolution-, and Mamba-based) and transfer paradigms: VP, Linear Probing (LP), Full Fine-tuning (FFT) and Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA). Our work builds up on previous findings by broadening the selection of evaluated models and techniques while tuning hyperparameters. In the interest of delivering practical guidelines for the user, we also explore application of prevalent regularization techniques to boost performance in the context of VP.
blocks.zh: 使基础模型适应培训领域内外的新任务是建立专门机器学习模型的实际标准。 最近,视觉刺激已成为高效知识转让的一种有希望的技术。 随着新的基建模式家庭被引入-(如曼巴),以及诸如AutoVP等VP管道的更成熟,我们发现越来越需要系统地评价目前的方法。 在这项工作中,我们评估了最新模型的性能,将其与早期的架构和替代的微调方法相比较,以更好地理解在资源限制下有效微调领域的进展、挑战和机遇。 为实现这一目标,本文件简明扼要地总结了基础模式家庭(以 " 留守 " 、 " 革命 " 和 " 曼巴 " 为基础)与转移模式之间的相互作用:VP、Linear Probing(LP)、Full Fine-t(FFT)和Low Rank Aditation(LORA)。 我们的工作以以前的调查结果为基础,在调整超参数的同时,扩大了评估模型和技术的选择范围。 为了向用户提供实用指南,我们还探索应用了普遍的规范化技术来提升在VP背景下的性能.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Efficient transfer of pretraining knowledge to new tasks and domains is an essential requirement for successful downstream applicability of foundation models. As the AI landscape continues to grow – spanning diverse architectures and design choices – so do options for fine-tuning, including new pipelines for Visual Prompting (VP), Linear Probing (LP), Full Fine-tuning (FFT) and Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA). For a review of these methods, please refer to Section 2 . Given this rapid expansion, it is critical to systematically and regularly assess how different architectural choices interact with various transfer learning methods. In this work, we present an empirical evaluation of VP across several prominent model architectures, analyze how performance correlates with pretraining accuracy, and discuss potential performance and compute tradeoffs when comparing it to other fine-tuning methods on challenging tasks.
blocks.zh: 将培训前知识高效地转移到新的任务和领域,是基础模型成功下游应用的基本要求。 随着AI景观的持续增长 — — 跨越了不同的建筑和设计选择 — — 微调的选项也是如此,包括视觉快速(VP),线性探测(LP),全微调(FFT)和低排名适应(LORA)的新管道. 关于这些方法的审查,请参阅第2节。 鉴于这种快速扩展,必须系统和定期评估不同的建筑选择如何与各种转移学习方法相互作用。 在这项工作中,我们对若干突出的模型结构的自愿参与进行实证评估,分析业绩如何与预先训练的准确性挂钩,并讨论潜在的业绩和在比较其他微调挑战性任务的方法时的权衡。

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en: VP, first introduced as Adversarial Reprogramming ( Elsayed et al., 2018 ) , leverages the idea of utilizing a universal input perturbation to transfer a pretrained model to a new domain or task. The term Prompting originates from language modeling ( Lester et al., 2021 ) and was later adapted to the vision domain ( Bahng et al., 2022 ) . VP keeps the pretrained source model entirely frozen and therefore differs from other techniques (see next paragraph) that may require adapting source model weights. Black-box variants of reprogramming can also work with API-only access ( Tsai et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: VP最初作为Adversarial Reprogramming(Elsayed et al., 2018)推出,它利用了利用通用输入扰动的想法,将预先训练过的模型转移到一个新的域或任务. Expointing一词源于语言建模(Lester等人,2021年),后来被改编为视觉域(Bahng等人,2022年). VP保持了预先训练的源模型完全冻结,因此不同于其他可能需要调整源模型权重的技术(见下段). 重新编程的黑盒变体也可以与API-只访问(Tsai等人,2020年)合作.

blocks.en: With AutoVP, Tsao et al. (2024) introduced improvements of the VP methodology as well as a unified benchmark for VP. The introduced improvements include the possibility of resizing the prompt as well as a new Label Mapping (LM) technique: Fully Connected Label Mapping (FCLM). FCLM is realized by a fully connected layer of dimensions C S × C T C_{S}\times C_{T} (# of source classes C S C_{S} ;# of target classes C T C_{T} ).
blocks.zh: 与AutoVP,曹等合著. (2024) 改进了自愿程序方法以及自愿程序的统一基准。 引进的改进包括可以重新调整速率大小,以及一种新的标签绘图技术:完全连接标签绘图(FCLM)。 FCLM是通过一个完全连接的维度层C S×实现的. C T 时间 CQQT}(#来源类 C S CQS};#目标类 C TCQT}).

blocks.en:
While there exists research on the combination of new foundation models and VP ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Tsao et al., 2024 ; Misra et al., 2024 ) , these works are either limited in model selection or didn’t tune hyperparameters, making the results ambiguous to interpret.
In this work, we evaluate a selection of ImageNet1k pretrained foundation models (Sec. 3 ) using AutoVP ( Tsao et al., 2024 ) on a common set of downstream image-classification tasks and in addition to performance (Tab. 1 and Fig. 1 ) also investigate on the behavior of models w.r.t. the resizing of the prompt (Tab. 6 and Fig. 2 ).
blocks.zh:
虽然对新基础模型和VP的结合存在研究(Chen等人,2023年;Tsao等人,2024年;Misra等人,2024年),但这些作品要么在模型选择上受到限制,要么没有调高参数,使得结果难以解释.
在这部作品中,我们评价了一组使用AutoVP(曹.等,2024年)的ImageNet1k预训基础模型(Sec. 3)在一套共同的下游图像分类任务上,除了性能(Tab. 1和Fig. 1)外,还调查模型w.r.t.重定速率(Tab. 6和Fig. 2)的行为.

blocks.en: Based on the improvements of AutoVP, we conduct a comparison of FFT, LP, LoRA  (described next) and VP on the data scarce DTD dataset ( Cimpoi et al., 2014 ) , which showed to be the most challenging task in the benchmark. We investigate a subset of the models evaluated in Tab. 1 , while tuning learning rate and weight decay to ensure optimal performance for each method. LP freezes the pretrained model, whilst only replacing and training a new classifier with the idea of leveraging the existing feature representations at the penultimate layer of a model ( Alain and Bengio, 2018 ) . In contrast to full fine-tuning, LP drastically reduces the amount of trainable parameters as well as hardware requirements. Last, in our implementation of FFT, we account for the new number of output classes by training a new classifier from scratch ( Chen et al., 2023 ) . In contrast to LP or VP, no model parameters are frozen. While this unlocks stronger results, it also requires larger compute and memory (Tab. 3 ) compared to the other approaches.
blocks.zh: 基于AutoVP的改进,我们对FFT,LP,LORA(下个描述)和VP进行了数据稀缺的DTD数据集的比较(Cimpoi等人,2014年),这些数据集显示是基准中最具挑战性的任务. 我们调查了Tab. 1中评估的模型的一个子集,同时调整学习率和重量衰减,以确保每种方法的最佳性能. LP冻结了预先训练过的模型,而只用在模型倒数第二层(Alain and Bengio, 2018)利用现有特征表达的想法来取代和训练新的分类器. 与完全微调相比,LP大幅降低了可训练参数的数量以及硬件需求. 最后,在我们实施FFT时,我们通过从零开始培训一名新的分类员来计算产出班数(Chen等人,2023年)。 相对于LP或VP,没有模型参数被冻结. 虽然这能解锁更强的成果,但与其他方法相比,还需要更大的计算和内存(第3段)。

blocks.en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) ( Hu et al., 2022 ) is one of the most prominent lines of PEFT research. Instead of updating the weight matrix W ∈ ℝ d × k W\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times k} directly, LoRA parametrizes the update as a product Δ ​ W = B ​ A \Delta W=BA , of low-rank B ∈ ℝ d × r B\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times r} , A ∈ ℝ r × k A\in\mathbb{R}^{r\times k} and hyperparameter r ≪ min ⁡ ( d , k ) r\ll\min(d,k) . Only A A and B B are trained, which drastically reduces the number of trainable parameters. Since the LoRA modules contain only these low-rank updates and not the base model’s weights, they are lightweight and can be swapped depending on the task, while the base model remains frozen and unchanged.
blocks.zh: 低朗克适应(Lora)(Hu等人,2022年)是PEFT研究最突出的台词之一. LoRA不直接更新权重矩阵 W → R d → k W\in\ mathb{ R\d\times k},而是将更新作为低档B → R d\ → r B\in\ mathb{ R\\d\times r} 和超参数r → min → (d, k) r\ll\ min (d,k) 的产品 → W = B A\\ D → 德尔塔 W= BA 只有A和B得到训练,这大大减少了可训练参数的数量. 由于LORA模块只包含这些低档更新,而不是基模型的权重,因此它们重量较轻,可以根据任务进行互换,而基模型则保持不变.

blocks.en: We noticed models showed signs of overfitting when being transferred to DTD using VP – as testified by Table 2 , where all models reached ≥ 𝟗𝟗 % \mathbf{\geq 99\%} training accuracy despite suboptimal test performance compared to LP, FFT or LoRA . This poses the question on how to effectively regularize VP. This task is particularly interesting, as common regularization methods are motivated by a different learning paradigm. We investigated a set of common regularization approaches while also ablating on targeting regularizing only to a subset of the optimized parameters in VP: either prompt or Label Mapping parameters. Specifically, we evaluated performance of Dropout ( Hinton et al., 2012 ) , L1-/L2-regularization, Sharpness-aware minimization (SAM) ( Foret et al., 2020 ) and Autoaugment ( Cubuk et al., 2019 ) .
blocks.zh: 正如表2所证明的, 所有模型都达到了99%\mathbf\geq 99%的训练精度, 尽管与LP、FFT或LORA相比, 这就提出了如何有效地规范《议定书》的问题。 这项任务特别有趣,因为共同的规范化方法是由不同的学习模式所推动的。 我们调查了一套共同的规范化方法,同时确定将规范化的目标仅仅放在自愿协议中的一些优化参数:即即时参数或标签绘图参数。 具体地说,我们评价了辍学(Hinton等人,2012年),L1-/L2-正规化,Sharpness-aware最小化(SAM)(Foret等人,2020年)和自动化(Cubuk等人,2019年)的业绩。

blocks.en: 3 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en:
The tasks are selected in accordance with earlier evaluations on VP ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Tsao et al., 2024 ) , consisting of CIFAR10/100 ( Krizhevsky and others, 2009 ) Flowers102 ( Nilsback and Zisserman, 2008 ) ,GTSRB ( Stallkamp et al., 2011 ) , DTD ( Cimpoi et al., 2014 ) , EuroSAT ( Helber et al., 2019 ) , Food101 ( Bossard et al., 2014 ) , OxfordPets ( Parkhi et al., 2012 ) . The models we use are VMamba 1 1 1 VMamba repository ( github.com/MzeroMiko/VMamba) ( Liu et al., 2024b ) , MambaOut 2 2 2 MambaOut repository ( github.com/yuweihao/MambaOut) ( Yu and Wang, 2025 ) , MambaVision 3 3 3 MambaVision repository ( github.com/NVlabs/MambaVision) ( Hatamizadeh and Kautz, 2024 ) , SwinT 4 4 4 Imported using torchvision ( maintainers and contributors, 2016 ) ( Liu et al., 2021 ) , ConvNext 4 4 4 Imported using torchvision ( maintainers and contributors, 2016 ) ( Liu et al., 2022 ) , ViT 4 4 4 Imported using torchvision ( maintainers and contributors, 2016 ) ( Dosovitskiy, 2020 ) and DeiT 5 5 5 Imported using timm ( Wightman, 2019 ) ( Touvron et al., 2021 ) .
In all cases, the ImageNet ( Deng et al., 2009 ) pretrained weights are utilized. • Our initial set of experiments (Table 1 and Section 4.1 ) involves training the previously introduced models – belonging to drastically different architecture families – on the AutoVP Benchmark ( Tsao et al., 2024 ) . For detailed information regarding hyperparameter tuning, please refer to Appendix A . • Our second series of experiments (Section 4.2 ) entails a comparative evaluation of LP, VP, FFT and LoRA on a subset of the introduced models. These fine-tuning paradigms are compared on the DTD dataset, as it appears to be the most challenging task with limited training data. • Our third set of experiments (Section 4.3 ) focuses on the regularization of VP. To assess regularization strategies on VP, we evaluate VMamba-B on the DTD Dataset (with Vanilla-VP performance obtainable from Table 1 ), utilizing a fixed learning rate of 0.001 0.001 . Dropout and L1/L2 regularization are implemented both across the entire model or specifically targeted to either the mapping or the prompt parameters. All runs from the first and second set of experiments are using a single Nvidia A100 GPU. The remaining experiments are utilizing either Nvidia Tesla V100 or Nvidia Quadro RTX 6000 GPUs.

blocks.en:
The evaluation of different fine-tuning techniques must consider the distinct computational requirements for training models of significant size. The precise calculation of trainable model parameters for the different approaches is contingent on numerous factors, including the selected model, input dimensions, and the number of target classes. For this comparison we assume VMamba-B being applied to the DTD dataset with 47 target classes. For VP, inputs are resized using a learnable prompt size, while for LP, FFT and LoRA they are resized to the input size 224 × 224 224\times 224 . Furthermore, while the trainable parameters of all approaches depend on the number of target classes, VP is also reliant on the input dimensions and the number of source classes in the pretrained model while LP also depends on the feature dimension of the penultimate layer. for LoRA, a rank of 2 was used to compute the reported number of parameters, as the different ranks all yielded similar results and therefore rank 2 showed to be the most lightweight variant reaching good performance. It is noteworthy that the implementation for LoRA in combination with VMamba was probably less optimized compared to the implementation for transformer based models.
Consequently, the reported numbers need to be interpreted within the context of the specific choice of pretrained model and task.
blocks.zh:
对不同微调技术的评价必须考虑到对规模较大的培训模式的不同计算要求。 不同方法的可训练模型参数的精确计算取决于许多因素,包括选定的模型、输入维度和目标类别的数目。 关于这一比较,我们假设VMamba-B正应用于有47个目标类别的DTD数据集。 对于 VP , 输入使用可学习的快速大小调整大小, 而对于 LP , FFT 和 LoRA , 输入大小调整为 224× 224\times 224 。 此外,虽然所有方法的可训练参数都取决于目标类别的数量,但VP还依赖于预训练模式中的输入维度和源类别的数量,而LP还依赖于倒数第二层的特征维度. 对于LORA来说,使用2级来计算所报告的参数数,因为不同的排名都得出了相似的结果,因此2级显示是最轻的变体,达到良好的性能. 值得注意的是,与基于变压器的模型相比,LORA和VMamba的实施工作可能没有那么优化。
因此,需要结合预先培训的模式和任务的具体选择来解释所报告的数字。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 VP levels model performances
blocks.zh: 4.1 VP级示范性能

blocks.en: Tab. 1 presents the model performances alongside the correlation between model performance and pretraining ImageNet accuracy. In general, raw ImageNet pretraining accuracy presents itself to be a determining factor for model performance, as validated by the reported correlation coefficient. This indicates an external validity of ImageNet-performance ( Torralba and Efros, 2011 ) . Nonetheless, certain tasks exhibit weak or even negative correlation.
blocks.zh: Tab. 1 介绍了模型性能与模型性能与预培训ImageNet精度之间的关联。 一般来说,原始的ImageNet预训精度呈现出自己是模型性能的决定因素,被报告的相关系数所验证. 这表明ImageNet-性能的外部有效性(Torralba和Efros,2011年)。 然而,某些任务显示出薄弱甚至负面的相关性。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Mean prompt size of the best performing run, with the initial prompt scaling being 1. Mean and standard deviation calculated over the tasks introduced in Sec. 3 .

blocks.en: ConvNext achieved the highest accuracy on four of the eight tasks. Yet, some tasks are more sensitive to model choice than others: while on CIFAR10 and EuroSAT performance differences are marginal, on DTD, the right selection of pretrained model is crucial.
blocks.zh: ConvNext在8项任务中的4项实现了最高准确度. 然而,有些任务对模型选择比其他任务更敏感:虽然在CIFAR10和EuroSAT性能差异很小,但在DTD上,正确选择事先训练过的模型至关重要.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Flowers102 performance of VMamba-T for combinations of ILM and FCLM with and without enabled resizing.
blocks.zh: 图3 Flowers102 用于ILM和FCLM的组合的VMamba-T的性能,有和无功能重排大小.

blocks.en: Our last investigation concerns the comparison with VP methods prior to Tsao et al. (2024) , and in particular with ILM-VP ( Chen et al., 2023 ) , tested also by Misra et al. (2024) . In contrast to ILM-VP, the variance in performance between different model architectures is significantly reduced. Using AutoVP on the Flowers102 dataset increases the performance of VMamba by 54.77 percentage points in comparison to ILM-VP, where it only reaches 38.9%. In comparison, ViT-B already achieves 83.1% under ILM-VP and is outperformed by VMamba under AutoVP.
blocks.zh: 我们上次的调查涉及与曹等人(2024年)之前的VP方法的比较,尤其是与同样由Misra等人(2024年)测试的ILM-VP(Chen等人,2023年)的比较. 与ILM-VP相比,不同模型架构的性能差异显著缩小. 使用Flowers102数据集上的AutoVP,与ILM-VP相比,VMamba的性能提高了54.77个百分点,仅达到38.9%. 相比之下,Vit-B在ILM-VP下已经实现83.1%的成绩,在AutoVP下被VMamba超越.

blocks.en:
For VMamba-T on Flowers102, our ablation separates the effects of label map-
ping and prompt resizing and identifies fully connected label mapping as the main source of the
improvement over ILM-VP (Fig. 3 ). As depicted in Fig. 2 , the capability to resize the prompt is not exploited uniformly across models.
ConvNext, which on average performs best, retains the initial configuration, while Swin-B exhibits considerable variation in prompt size. Models differing only by size (e.g., MambaVision, VMamba) tend to have similar behavior, while Swin Transformer behaves as an outlier with Swin-T maintaining the initial prompt size and Swin-B showing variation. Detailed results can be found in Appendix A .

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison training paradigms
blocks.zh: 4.2 比较培训模式

blocks.en: As showcased in Tab. 3 , for the specific setting described above, LP proves to be the most lightweight fine-tuning method, with VP being only slightly more hardware demanding. By requiring only about 15% of the GPU-memory required for FFT, the field of application is drastically broadened by, in contrast to FFT, being able to e.g. run on a Nvidia Tesla V100 GPU. LoRA manages to outperform FFT on 5 of the 6 evaluated models, surprisingly not showing substantial differences between different rank configurations (See tab. 4 ).
blocks.zh: 如塔布所示。 3,对于上述具体设置,LP被证明是最轻量级的微调方法,VP只要求略高的硬件. FFT只需要大约15%的GPU-memory,与FFT相反,应用领域被大幅拓宽,例如能够运行在Nvidia Tesla V100 GPU上. LORA在6个评估模型中,有5个模型的性能超过了FFT,令人惊讶的是,没有显示出不同级别配置之间的实质性差异(见标签)。 页:1

blocks.en: Table 4: Top 1 test-performance in % for different rank configurations.
blocks.zh: 表4:不同军衔配置前1位测试性能(%).

blocks.en: It is also noteworthy, that whilst the majority of research conducted on LoRA is in combination with Transformer-based architectures, even a naive implementation on Mamba- and Convolution-based architectures shows to be an efficient way of fine-tuning, making it thereby easily applicable for a variety of tasks. Whilst LoRA outperforming FFT is generally not a novel observation on language modeling ( Liu et al., 2024a ) , the transfer to image classification offers great potential for downstream applicability to further domains.
blocks.zh: 同样值得注意的是,虽然对LORA进行的大多数研究都与基于变形器的建筑相结合,但即使对Mamba和Convolution建筑的天真实施也显示出是一种有效的微调方式,因此很容易适用于各种任务。 虽然LORA优于FFT一般不是关于语言建模的新型观察(Liu等人,2024a),但向图像分类的转移为下游适用于更多领域提供了巨大的潜力。

blocks.en: 4.3 Regularization of VP
blocks.zh: 4.3 将自愿保证金正规化

blocks.en:
Applying L1 regularization to either the prompt generation and the Label Mapping leads to almost similar enhancements. Conversely, for L2 regularization, regularizing the Label Mapping is substantially more effective than regularizing the prompt.
The augmentation schemes from Cubuk et al. ( 2019 ) , which are derived from ImageNet, SVHN, and CIFAR10, increased performance, however to the smallest degree. VMamba also benefits from the utilization of SAM as well as from applying Dropout to the Label Mapping.
blocks.zh:
将L1规范化应用于即时生成和Label映射导致几乎类似的增强。 相反,就L2正规化而言,将Label绘图规范化比将及时性规范化有效得多。
Cubuk等人(2019年)的增强计划来自ImageNet、SVHN和CIFAR10,但提高了业绩,但程度最小。 VMamba还受益于SAM的利用,以及将辍学应用于标签绘图。

blocks.en: Table 5: AutoVP performances of VMamba-B using different regularization mechanics. First row reports the unregularized VP performance.
blocks.zh: 表5:VMamba-B使用不同规范力学的自动VP性能. 第一行报告未规范的VP性能.

blocks.en:
For VMamba-B on DTD, the tested regularizers improve VP accuracy but leave a gap
to LoRA. Also, no single regularization method can completely close the performance gap between VMamba and ConvNext.
blocks.zh:
对于DTD上的VMamba-B,经过测试的规范化器提高了VP的精度,但留下了空白.
给洛拉 另外,没有任何单一的规范化方法能够完全弥合VMamba和ConvNext之间的性能差距.

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en:
The VMamba-T ablation on Flowers102 shows that the choice of label mapping
can strongly affect visual prompting performance, highlighting the importance of the adaptation
procedure when assessing a pretrained model. When employing VP, our results show that the selection should consider both its pretraining accuracy and the model architecture, with ConvNext being the best option in our setup. In particular on data scarce tasks, LoRA seems to be the method of choice, outperforming FFT while being lightweight.
blocks.zh:
Flowers102上的VMamba-T bulling显示,标签映射的选择
能够强烈影响视觉激发性能,突出适应的重要性
评估预先训练的模型的程序。 在使用 VP 时, 我们的结果显示, 选择时既应考虑其预训精度, 也应考虑模型结构, 将 ConvNext 作为我们设置中的最佳选项 。 尤其是关于数据稀缺的任务,LORA似乎是选择的方法,在轻量级的同时表现优于FFT.
